basics.name: Jordan Reyes
basics.label: Platform Engineer · Cloud Native · Home Lab Enthusiast
basics.summary: SAMPLE CONTENT for the template; replace with your own. Platform engineer who builds and runs the infrastructure behind high-traffic products: Kubernetes, GitOps delivery, observability, and the developer platforms that let teams ship safely every day.

work.name: Acme Talent (sample employer)
work.summary: Owned the Kubernetes platform behind a large recruiting marketplace serving millions of candidates and employers.
highlights: Migrated 40+ services from VM-based deploys to Kubernetes with Argo CD GitOps, cutting lead time for changes from days to under an hour.
Built the observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo) and SLO-based alerting that reduced on-call pages by 60%.
Designed multi-region ingress with cert-manager, external-dns and Cloudflare, achieving 99.95% availability over 18 months.

work.name: Northwind Logistics (sample employer)
work.summary: Built CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for a logistics SaaS platform.
highlights: Replaced hand-built Jenkins pipelines with GitHub Actions and reusable workflows across 25 repositories.
Introduced Terraform modules and policy-as-code (OPA) that brought cloud spend down 30% year over year.
Led incident response process and blameless post-mortems.

work.name: Contoso Health (sample employer)
work.summary: Ran on-prem Linux and Windows infrastructure for a regional healthcare provider.
highlights: Virtualized 120 physical servers onto a Proxmox and VMware fleet.
Automated patching and configuration with Ansible, cutting maintenance windows in half.
